reason: The new goal asks to connect the pulling tissue to the skeleton, and the bundles have tendon ends.

effect: The completed arm shows how muscles attached on opposite sides can pull the elbow in opposite directions; all chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The two views made bending and straightening easier to picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscle bundles to the skeleton was most worthwhile because the result showed how two pulling muscles move the same joint in opposite directions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones to the named elbow joint was fairly predictable, though the picture helped explain the joint surfaces.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that bone combines hard mineral and tough fibres while still containing living cells and blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the goals and pictures gave a clear purpose for each pairing.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because building the arm connected familiar body parts to how they work, especially the opposing muscle pulls.
